This position is the Site Manager at Waco Mammoth National Monument (WACO), located in Waco, Texas. This position reports directly to the Superintendent of Lyndon B. Johnson National Historical Park (LYJO), located in Johnson City, Texas approximately 2.5 hours from the site.

The incumbent is responsible for planning, managing, directing, and evaluating a complex and multifaceted program of interpretation, resource education, visitor services, community outreach, youth programming and partnerships.

The employee is also responsible for coordinating resource management, facility management, administrative, and law enforcement services with the relevant program leads at LYJO. Determines strategic direction, goals, and objectives for Waco Mammoth National Monument.

Responsible for all aspects of management of the park through subordinate staff including planning and programming, public relations, administration, resource management, safety, interpretation, visitor services, and facilities maintenance.

Fosters and maintains external relationships and partnerships, such as with community organizations, Native American tribes, elected officials, stakeholders and partners. Builds coalitions internally and with other federal agencies, state and local governments, and non-profit and private sector organizations to achieve common goals.

Ensures compliance with all federal laws and National Park Service (NPS) policies, ensuring that the park's financial and other resources are used strategically and effectively to meet NPS objectives. For more information about Waco Mammoth National Monument, please visit: Waco Mammoth National Monument (U.S. National Park Service).

OpenAI’s Compute organization is building the physical infrastructure required to support the next generation of AI systems. We are developing and scaling large, complex data center campuses that integrate high-density compute, power, cooling, networking, and supporting infrastructure at unprecedented speed and scale.
The Construction organization is responsible for translating these designs into operating facilities. We work across engineering, infrastructure delivery, procurement, supply chain, commissioning, operations, and external construction partners to safely deliver highly complex data center infrastructure on aggressive schedules.
As OpenAI’s infrastructure footprint expands, we are looking for construction leaders who can operate effectively in high-velocity environments, manage large contractor ecosystems, and develop repeatable approaches to delivering increasingly complex facilities.

We are seeking a Senior Construction Manager to lead field execution for large-scale AI data center projects from mobilization through commissioning and operational handoff.
This role will serve as a senior construction leader and primary point of contact for general contractors, trade partners, and other external construction organizations. You will be responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary construction activities, driving schedule performance, resolving field issues, and ensuring that infrastructure is delivered safely, efficiently, and to the required technical standards.
The role requires someone who is equally comfortable operating at the project level and in the field: reviewing designs for constructability, developing construction sequencing, coordinating thousands of workers and multiple trades, identifying bottlenecks, and making rapid decisions when conditions change.
You will work closely with engineering, commissioning, infrastructure delivery, procurement, logistics, and operations teams to accelerate delivery while maintaining a high bar for quality, safety, and reliability.

Lead construction execution for large-scale data center campuses and critical infrastructure from site mobilization through commissioning and operational handoff.
Serve as a senior field leader and primary point of contact for general contractors, trade contractors, and construction partners across assigned projects.
Direct large multidisciplinary contractor organizations across electrical, mechanical, structural, civil, controls, networking, and data hall construction activities.
Develop and drive construction sequencing strategies that enable parallel execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining safety, quality, and schedule integrity.
Own construction schedules, progress reporting, critical-path management, and recovery plans for projects operating under aggressive delivery timelines.
Review engineering designs and construction documents for constructability, identifying opportunities to simplify execution, reduce field conflicts, and accelerate installation.
Partner with engineering and design teams to resolve constructability issues before they become field constraints and minimize unnecessary RFIs and rework.
Lead rapid field problem solving across construction, engineering, commissioning, and contractor teams, making decisions that keep projects moving.
Coordinate construction activities with equipment deliveries, logistics, commissioning, energization, and infrastructure readiness requirements.
Establish clear performance expectations for contractors and trade partners, and hold them accountable for safety, schedule, quality, productivity, and execution.
Support contractor selection, onboarding, scope development, and performance management across major construction packages.
Identify construction risks, emerging schedule constraints, resource bottlenecks, and interface issues and develop mitigation strategies before they impact project delivery.
Partner with commissioning teams to ensure systems are installed, tested, and transitioned into operational readiness according to project requirements.
Develop scalable construction processes, reporting mechanisms, and execution standards that can be applied across OpenAI’s growing data center portfolio.
Provide senior leadership with clear visibility into project status, critical risks, contractor performance, schedule confidence, and required decisions.

10+ years of experience leading construction delivery for large-scale data centers, industrial facilities, semiconductor facilities, power infrastructure, or other highly complex mission-critical environments.
Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or high-density data center infrastructure with significant electrical and mechanical complexity.
Proven ability to lead very large contractor and trade workforces across multiple simultaneous construction workstreams.
Deep understanding of data center construction sequencing, including data halls, electrical distribution, mechanical systems, controls, cooling infrastructure, and supporting site infrastructure.
Strong understanding of constructability and the ability to translate engineering designs into practical, executable field plans.
Experience managing aggressive construction schedules and developing innovative sequencing or parallelization strategies to materially accelerate delivery.
Strong field-based problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound technical and operational decisions under significant time pressure.
Experience managing general contractors, specialty contractors, vendors, and construction consultants across complex project environments.
Strong understanding of construction project controls, including critical path scheduling, progress measurement, forecasting, productivity, and recovery planning.
Experience leading construction through commissioning, energization, integrated systems testing, and operational handoff.
Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve construction issues directly with field engineers, contractors, and trade partners rather than relying solely on formal escalation processes.
Experience with contractor procurement, bid evaluation, scope development, and contractor performance management.
Strong understanding of construction safety requirements and the ability to maintain a high safety standard across large and rapidly scaling workforces.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with executives, engineers, contractors, vendors, and field personnel.
Experience working in fast-moving environments where priorities, designs, schedules, and execution plans can change rapidly.
Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Willingness to spend significant time in the field and travel regularly to active construction sites.
About OpenAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

You will serve as a GENERAL ENGINEER - Senior Construction Manager and be responsible to serve as a Construction/Design Project Manager within a multi-disciplinary architectural and engineering team on design-build projects. Being a Coast Guard civilian makes you a valuable member of the Coast Guard team.

Typical work assignments include: Lead, manage, and direct complex engineering and architectural projects by adapting standard precedents, modifying established practices, and developing innovative solutions to resolve highly diverse and technical engineering challenges.

Direct and execute all assigned projects as a technical authority, independently providing expert recommendations and policy guidance to ensure final submissions are viable, technically accurate, and accepted with minimal revision.

Direct the interpretation of broad, non-specific technical and regulatory policies by applying seasoned judgment to deviate from traditional practices, resolve unprecedented challenges, and establish new engineering methodologies.

Command and execute the resolution of complex, unprecedented engineering challenges by interpreting broad regulatory policies, departing from traditional practices, and establishing new technical standards.

Avert and resolve critical, highly unusual engineering problems and policy gaps by pioneering innovative technical approaches and initiating proactive administrative and socioeconomic actions to prevent project delays and cost escalations.
Basic Requirements: This position has a positive Education Requirement in addition to at least one year of Specialized Experience or substitution of education for experience or combination (if applicable) in order to be found minimally qualified. Transcripts must be submitted with your application package.

You MUST meet the following requirements: Degree: Engineering.

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics.

OR Combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

(The above examples of related curricula are not all-inclusive.) To qualify at the GS-13 grade level, your resume must demonstrate at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-12 grade level in the federal sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Examples of specialized experience include performing the following types of tasks on a regular basis.

Knowledge of specialty areas in civil engineering and construction management sufficient to apply new developments and theories to critical and novel problems.

Architectural/ engineering contracting methods, precedents, and standards Knowledge of design, construction, and cost estimating techniques to enable determination of technical feasibility and estimated costs for shore and in-water materials, and services.

NOTE: All experience statements (i.e., duties, specialized experience, or related applicable assessment) copied from this announcement and pasted into your resume will not be considered as a demonstration of your qualifications for this position. NOTE: Education cannot be substituted for experience at this grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

### **Beschreibung** ###
As a first-tier supplier to our renowned business partner F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. in Kaiseraugst, we are currently looking for a motivated and dedicated **Global CMO Clinical Packaging Site Manager** for a temporary assignment of 11 months.
This role is responsible for the operational and strategic management of clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly outsourced to a global network of Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs). Operating within a strictly regulated GxP/GMP environment, the position serves as the central operational link between internal supply chain functions, procurement, and external manufacturing partners.
The core focus encompasses end-to-end CMO project execution-from initial onboarding, RFPs, and SOW contracting to budget ownership, SAP order processing, and active S&OP representation. The goal is to ensure reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective clinical supply delivery to meet global trial timelines.

* CMO Site Management: Organize and oversee clinical drug labeling, packaging, and device assembly production outsourced to a global network of CMOs.
* Project & Delivery Oversight: Proactively manage CMO project onboarding, communications, timelines, and delivery performance for outsourced clinical packaging orders to meet supply chain needs while adhering to cost and quality standards.
* Procurement & Contracting: Partner with Procurement and key stakeholders to drive Request for Proposals (RFPs) and Statements of Work (SOWs), negotiate supply agreements, and select vendors.
* Strategy & Budgeting: Support leadership in defining supply strategies for non-standard supply chains. Own the budgeting process and submission for CMO project variable costs.
* Process Ownership & Governance: Establish team scope and division of responsibilities with upstream functions (e.g., device CMO team). Define, track, and report CMO team KPIs.
* S&OP Representation: Actively drive network supply outcomes and represent the CMO function in the CD&OP process.
* Managing operational orders, and master data in SAP
* Supplier Relationship Management (SRM): Lead SRM activities and partner with CMOs to ensure long-term capability and capacity for predictable delivery.
* Financial & Order Execution: Create and maintain Purchase Orders in the purchasing system, review/approve CMO invoices, and execute pre- and post-production order management in the ERP system.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify and champion process improvement opportunities, applying technical expertise to resolve complex supply chain issues. Serve as an SME/primary contact for key strategic initiatives.

* Solid understanding of pharma supply chains, contract manufacturing, and clinical operations.
* Proven project planning, project management, and resource management skills.
* Strong leadership experience in taking projects from initiation through final delivery.
* High cultural awareness and social competence for global stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and system-oriented skills with high attention to detail.
* High integrity and the ability to operate independently with minimal direction.

Mit deiner Erfahrung in der Bauleitung verantwortest und leitest du die Ausführung von Infrastrukturprojekten selbständig. Mit deinen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten bildest du die Schnittstelle zu den Bauherren und Anlagebetreibern und übernimmst die Koordination der Projektaufgaben und die Leitung von verschiedenen Sitzungen.

Dabei trägst du die Verantwortung für das Vertrags-Controlling und stellst sicher, dass das ausgeführte Werk der Bestellung der Bauherrschaft entspricht. Dies ermöglichen wir dir durch eigene Initiativen, den Austausch mit internen Sparringpartnern sowie attraktive Weiterbildungsangebote.
Unser breites Angebot an internen Anlässen – sei es bei sportlichen Aktivitäten oder Projektveranstaltungen – fördert die Vernetzung und den Austausch im Team.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur zeichnet sich durch einen lebendigen Austausch und die prestigefreie Zusammenarbeit zwischen jungen und erfahrenen Fachleuten und verschiedenen Disziplinen aus. Querdenker:innen und Visionär:innen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen.

Nutze die einzigartige Gelegenheit und werde Teil des Projektteams für den Ausbau des Bahnhofs Bern. Leiste einen massgebenden Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Realisierung eines der bedeutendsten Infrastrukturprojekte der Schweiz und gestalte die Mobilität kommender Generationen aktiv mit.

Das bewegst du

Mit deiner Erfahrung in der Bauleitung übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Ausführung anspruchsvoller Ingenieurbauarbeiten im Rahmen des Ausbaus der neuen Publikumsanlage des Bahnhofs Bern. Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Projektteams begleitest du die Bauarbeiten von der Ausführung bis zur Fertigstellung und trägst dazu bei, dass dieses technisch komplexe und national bedeutende Infrastrukturprojekt erfolgreich umgesetzt wird.

Als Bauleiter:in bist du zentrale Ansprechperson für die ausführenden Unternehmungen, das Projektteam sowie für weitere Projektbeteiligte. Du koordinierst Baustellenabläufe, Termine und Ressourcen und stellst einen reibungslosen Bauablauf vor Ort sicher.

Gleichzeitig überwachst du Qualität, Kosten, Termine und Arbeitssicherheit und sorgst dafür, dass die Projektziele zuverlässig erreicht werden. Dank deiner ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeit gelingt es dir, die unterschiedlichen Interessen und Anforderungen der Projektbeteiligten zusammenzuführen und gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Das bringst du mit

Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Bauleitung von Ingenieur- oder Infrastrukturbauten und bringst einen Abschluss als Bauleiter:in, Techniker:in HF oder Bauingenieur:in (FH/ETH) mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrungen in komplexen Infrastrukturprojekten gesammelt und begeisterst dich für anspruchsvolle Bauvorhaben.

Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und verantwortungsbewusst. Mit deinem Durchsetzungsvermögen, deiner Organisationstärke und deiner lösungsorientierten Denkweise behältst du auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick. Der sichere Umgang mit den gängigen Softwaretools im Bauwesen rundet dein Profil ab.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Wir bieten dir die Chance, an einem Jahrhundertprojekt mitzuwirken und nachhaltige Spuren in der Schweizer Infrastruktur zu hinterlassen. Dich erwartet ein motiviertes und interdisziplinäres Team, das gemeinsam an der erfolgreichen Umsetzung eines aussergewöhnlichen Bauvorhabens arbeitet.

Neben spannenden Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen sowie attraktive Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Mit unserer internen Academy und einem breiten Netzwerk an Fachexpert:innen unterstützen wir dich dabei, dein Wissen im Alltag kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Gerne stellen wir dir im persönlichen Austausch weitere Benefits vor.

Das zeichnet uns aus

Bei uns begegnen sich junge und erfahrene Fachpersonen auf Augenhöhe und wir setzen auf gegenseitigen Respekt sowie eine unkomplizierte, prestigefreie Atmosphäre. Den Austausch im Team und über unsere zahlreichen Fachbereiche und Funktionen hinweg erachten wir als wichtig und selbstverständlich. Zudem arbeiten wir gemeinsam an einer effizienten Projektabwicklung und unterstützen uns dabei gegenseitig. Wir legen grossen Wert darauf, dass Teammitglieder ihr volles Potenzial entfalten können.

Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Bauleitung von Infrastrukturbauwerken und über einen Abschluss als Bauingenieur:in (FH/ETH), eidg. dipl. Bauleiter:in, Techniker:in HF oder eidg. dipl. Bauführer:in. Du bist interessiert, dein Wissen mit unserer Unterstützung zu festigen und zukünftig auch weitere Aufgaben als Bauleiter:in zu übernehmen.

Die Zusammenarbeit und den gegenseitigen Austausch mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen bereitet dir Freude. Zudem spornen dich fachlichen Herausforderungen an und du möchtest aktiv dazu beitragen, den Fach- und Geschäftsbereich weiterzubringen.

Neben der fachlichen Weiterbildung bieten wir mit unserer internen Academy auch ein Weiterbildungsprogramm an, das dich mit dem nötigen Rüstzeug für die Projektabwicklung ausstattet. Nous recherchons une personne de terrain, dynamique et polyvalente, capable d'assurer à la fois le pilotage opérationnel d'un atelier CNC, le soutien technique aux équipes et le management quotidien d'une équipe d'environ 12 collaborateurs.
Po
### Description du job ###
* Organiser et piloter l'activité quotidienne de l'atelier CNC, en assurant le suivi du plan de production, des priorités et des délais.
* Encadrer, accompagner et faire monter en compétences une équipe stable et collaborative d'environ 12 personnes.
* Apporter un soutien technique direct sur le terrain : réglages, programmation, mise au point, optimisation et résolution des problématiques d'usinage.
* Programmer et optimiser les usinages sur machines CNC, notamment via Alphacam et commandes FANUC / Robodrill.
* Garantir la polyvalence humaine et technique sur le parc machines afin d'assurer la continuité de production.
* Suivre et améliorer les performances de l'atelier : qualité, productivité, temps d'usinage, flux et méthodes de travail.
* Collaborer avec les services support et être le relais terrain auprès de la production, avec une approche pragmatique et orientée solutions.

* Une fonction très terrain, avec une forte autonomie technique et organisationnelle.
* Le management d'une équipe d'environ 12 collaborateurs dans un climat de travail sain et collaboratif.
* Des horaires de journée et de bonnes conditions d' engagement.
* Un processus de recrutement confidentiel et un accompagnement discret tout au long de la démarche.
### Profil ###
* CFC Polymécanicien, Technicien ES en mécanique ou formation jugée équivalente.
* Solide expérience en usinage CNC dans un environnement horloger, microtechnique ou composants de précision.
* Maîtrise des réglages, de la programmation et des optimisations d'usinage ; connaissances d'Alphacam et/ou FANUC appréciées.
* Expérience confirmée dans l'encadrement d'équipe ou réel potentiel de management de terrain.
* Profil polyvalent, capable de passer de la coordination d'atelier à l'intervention directe sur machine.
* Leadership simple, naturel et fédérateur, avec une communication claire et une forte présence terrain.
* Personnalité dynamique, autonome, structurée et orientée amélioration continue.
* Orienté terrain, dynamique et capable de prendre des décisions opérationnelles

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects.

The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management.

Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers.

The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.

Job Description
Olsson has an exciting opportunity to work directly with one of the world's largest technology companies. As a Construction Project Manager, you will lead the construction closeout process for complex data center projects, ensuring all documentation, redlines, as-builts, and turnover deliverables are completed accurately, on time, and to the highest quality standards.
In this role, you will oversee closeout activities from field verification through final turnover, managing redline processes, conducting as-built audits, performing QA/QC reviews of project deliverables, and coordinating with contractors, trade partners, and project stakeholders. You will be responsible for driving accountability, identifying and resolving issues that could impact project schedules, and ensuring all closeout requirements are met.
The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of mechanical and electrical systems, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, technical problem-solving abilities, and a proven track record of delivering complex projects with a high degree of quality and accuracy.

Working collaboratively with others.
Having ownership in the work you do.
Using your talents to positively affect communities.

Lead and manage construction closeout activities for large-scale data center projects.
Oversee and coordinate the collection, review, and approval of redlines, as-builts, O&M manuals, warranties, and other closeout documentation.
Perform field verification audits to validate as-built conditions and ensure documentation accuracy.
Conduct QA/QC reviews of project deliverables to verify completeness, consistency, and compliance with project requirements.
Hold contractors, trade partners, and stakeholders accountable for meeting closeout milestones and documentation requirements.
Monitor closeout schedules, identify risks, and proactively drive corrective actions to maintain project timelines.
Utilize knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems to review technical deliverables and resolve discrepancies.
Communicate project status, risks, and action items to internal and external stakeholders.
Continuously improve closeout processes and documentation standards to support efficient project turnover.

Additional Information
Olsson specializes in engineering and design, client advisory services, planning, field services, and environmental. Improving the world has been our mindset from the very beginning, back when Olsson first opened for business in 1956. And it will be our mindset for years to come.

Site Contracts Manager, II (Sponsor‑Dedicated /Remote – US Based)
Are you a contracts expert who thrives on navigating complexity, building strong site partnerships, and driving timelines forward? Syneos Health is seeking a Site Contracts Manager, II to support a sponsor‑dedicated program focused on high‑impact Pharma & Vaccine studies. If you’re energized by problem‑solving, negotiation, and leading projects across multiple therapeutic areas—especially oncology—we’d love to meet you.

As a Site Contracts Manager , II you’ll serve as a strategic expert responsible for developing, negotiating, and managing US site budgets and clinical trial agreements. You’ll collaborate closely with internal teams, external stakeholders, and major academic institutions to craft robust contracts that support operational excellence while minimizing risk.
This role is perfect for a communicator, leader, and negotiator who’s ready to hit the ground running and make an immediate impact.

Budgeting & Template Development
Negotiate budgets from start to finish from a Sponsor perspective directly with clinical sites.
Fully understand budget and contract language for Pharma & Vaccine clinical trials.
Develop and refine templates to support consistency, compliance, and strategic study needs.
Contract Negotiation & Risk Management
Lead direct negotiations with large academic institutions and other critical stakeholders.
Draft and finalize clinical trial agreements that balance business objectives with legal and operational protections.
Conduct due diligence checks—such as FMV assessments and site justification reviews—when initial offers are declined.
Determine when requests require budget or language escalation and secure appropriate approvals.
Project Leadership & Delivery
Prioritize and lead multiple contracting projects across several therapeutic areas (oncology experience strongly preferred).
Proactively escalate risks, timeline impacts, or delays that could affect CTA execution.
Tools, Systems & Communication
Demonstrate expert proficiency in Excel and clinical trial management systems.
Communicate effectively in both written and verbal formats, incorporating feedback seamlessly.
Maintain accurate and timely updates in departmental trackers and databases.
Compliance, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
Deepen and maintain knowledge of GCP, sponsor processes, SOPs, work instructions, and new technologies.
Build strong working relationships with internal and external partners.
Support and train additional team members as needed.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives that simplify workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.
Take on ad‑hoc tasks and diverse projects with a solutions‑oriented mindset.

Oncology therapeutic area experience
Prior experience with pharma, CRO, or investigative sites
Strong project management skills and comfort leading cross‑functional efforts
Experience leveraging AI in the contracts and budgets space

2+ years of experience working in a fast paced and volume driven work environment
Direct experience negotiating with large academic institutions
Ability to juggle priorities, lead projects, and deliver results under tight timelines

## **Ta mission :** ##
En tant que chef de chantier électricien, tu supervises et coordonnes l-ensemble des travaux électriques sur différents chantiers, aussi bien en construction neuve qu-en rénovation.
Tu garantis la bonne exécution des installations électriques dans le respect des plans, des normes en vigueur, des délais, des consignes de sécurité et des exigences de qualité.

* Analyser, interpréter et valider les plans électriques ainsi que la documentation technique associée
* Planifier, organiser et coordonner les interventions des équipes d-électriciens et des éventuels sous-traitants
* Superviser la réalisation des installations électriques sur chantier
* Encadrer la pose des tableaux électriques, chemins de câbles, conduits, gaines techniques et systèmes automatisés
* Organiser la mise en place des conduits, gaines, supports et autres éléments nécessaires à la bonne exécution des travaux
* Assurer le suivi de l-avancement du chantier et veiller au respect des délais
* Contrôler la qualité des travaux réalisés et le respect des consignes techniques
* Participer aux contrôles, tests et mises en service des installations électriques
* Identifier les problématiques techniques rencontrées sur le terrain et proposer des solutions adaptées
* Veiller au strict respect des règles de sécurité
* Maintenir un chantier propre, ordonné et sécurisé
* Assurer une communication efficace avec le client, le bureau d-études, la direction des travaux et les autres corps de métier
* Garantir une bonne coordination entre les différents intervenants du chantier
## **Maintenant si on parlait de toi ?** ##
Tu es titulaire d-un CFC d-installateur-électricien ou d-une formation équivalente reconnue en Suisse.
Tu bénéficies d-une expérience confirmée dans la gestion de chantiers électriques, en construction neuve comme en rénovation. Tu maîtrises les installations techniques, les normes en vigueur et l-encadrement d-équipes sur le terrain.
Organisé, réactif et orienté solutions, tu sais prendre des décisions, anticiper les problématiques de chantier et garantir une exécution propre, fiable et conforme aux exigences du métier.

Du hast idealerweise fachliche Weiterbildungen und Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams.
Du besitzt einen gültigen Fahrausweis der Kategorie B.
Du gehst Herausforderungen selbständig und mit einer strukturierten und verantwortungsbewussten Haltung an.

Bei CKW setzen wir uns für eine Kultur der Nichtdiskriminierung, Toleranz und Inklusion ein. **Megasol Energie AG** fait partie des principaux fabricants suisses de modules solaires innovants et de solutions photovoltaïques intégrées aux bâtiments. À notre siège principal à Deitingen, nous réunissons développement, production, vente et logistique sous un même toit.
Pour diriger notre service commercial interne, nous recherchons une personne qui ne se contente pas de prendre des responsabilités, mais qui les revendique activement. Vous veillez à ce que les offres, commandes, planifications et envois internationaux soient traités rapidement, de manière fiable et évolutive. En même temps, vous développez votre département de manière organisationnelle et digitale de façon cohérente.
Ce poste s'adresse à des personnes qui ont des exigences élevées envers leur propre performance, qui aiment façonner les choses et ne laissent pas les résultats au hasard.
### **Vos responsabilités** ###
Vous dirigez le service commercial interne sur le plan professionnel, personnel et organisationnel et êtes responsable de la performance, de la qualité et de la fiabilité de votre département.

En même temps, vous faites partie intégrante des opérations quotidiennes, travaillez activement en équipe chaque jour et assumez la responsabilité en cas de situations critiques, de goulets d'étranglement et d'escalades.

Ainsi, vous connaissez les processus de première main, détectez rapidement les points faibles et développez votre équipe de manière cohérente.

* Responsabilité globale du service commercial interne, de la planification ainsi que de la gestion des commandes et des offres
* Participation opérationnelle continue aux offres, commandes, planifications et demandes clients
* Assurer un traitement rapide, correct et contraignant des commandes
* Gestion de l'équipe selon des objectifs clairs, des responsabilités et des standards de performance mesurables
* Développement ciblé des collaborateurs pour constituer une équipe compétente et autonome
* Coordination des envois nationaux et internationaux, y compris la documentation complète d'expédition, d'exportation et de dédouanement
* Conduite de l'introduction du nouveau système ERP et garantie de son application cohérente au sein du département
* Numérisation et optimisation des processus avec des améliorations mesurables en qualité, rapidité et transparence
* Mise en place de délégations claires ainsi que d'un système efficace de gestion et de contrôle
* Contrôle rigoureux de la mise en œuvre, du respect et de l'ancrage durable des processus convenus
### **Comment nous mesurons votre succès** ###
Nous ne recherchons pas une personne qui présente uniquement de nouveaux concepts. Ce qui compte, c'est ce qui fonctionne mieux de manière mesurable dans les opérations quotidiennes.

* Les offres et commandes sont traitées rapidement, correctement et de manière contraignante
* Les clients reçoivent à tout moment des informations fiables sur les délais et le statut des commandes
* Les responsabilités et les processus au sein du département sont clairement définis
* Les envois nationaux et internationaux sont traités complètement et sans retards évitables
* Les taux d'erreur, les demandes de renseignements et les doubles travaux manuels diminuent de manière mesurable
* Le nouveau système ERP est compris, accepté et utilisé de manière cohérente par votre équipe
* Les processus introduits ne sont pas seulement documentés, mais vécus et contrôlés au quotidien
* Votre équipe travaille de manière performante, structurée et orientée solutions même en cas de volume élevé de commandes
### **Ce que vous apportez** ###
* Expérience de plusieurs années dans une fonction de direction comparable dans le service commercial interne, la gestion des commandes, le service client ou la planification
* Succès démontrables dans la gestion et le développement d'équipes
* Très bonne compréhension des processus complets de commande, logistique et client
* Expérience avec les envois internationaux ainsi que les documents d'exportation et de dédouanement
* Expérience pratique dans l'introduction ou le développement d'un système ERP
* Compétences digitales prononcées et capacité à identifier et mettre en œuvre des potentiels d'automatisation
* Esprit entrepreneurial ainsi qu'exigence élevée en matière de qualité, rapidité et fiabilité
* Rigueur dans la mise en œuvre : vous signalez les écarts, prenez des décisions et veillez à leur respect
* Force d'analyse sans vous perdre dans des concepts théoriques
* Communication claire, directe et respectueuse - même dans des situations exigeantes
### **Langues** ###
L'allemand est indispensable. De plus, vous maîtrisez au moins une des trois langues suivantes :
* Anglais
* Français
* Italien
### **Ce qui vous attend chez Megasol** ###
* Un poste clé avec une influence directe sur la satisfaction client, la capacité de livraison et la croissance de l'entreprise
* Une grande marge de manœuvre et des voies de décision courtes
* La possibilité de façonner durablement les structures, systèmes et méthodes de travail
* Une entreprise suisse technologiquement leader et en forte expansion
* Un environnement exigeant où l'initiative et les améliorations mesurables sont expressément souhaitées
* Beaucoup d'autonomie ainsi que des possibilités attractives de développement professionnel et personnel
* Une activité porteuse de sens dans une entreprise qui fait avancer concrètement la transition énergétique avec des produits innovants
### **Ce poste vous correspond-il ?** ###
Si vous souhaitez seulement gérer les processus existants, ce poste n'est pas fait pour vous.
Si, en revanche, vous voulez diriger un département, rendre la performance visible, améliorer les processus de manière cohérente et porter une unité organisationnelle centrale au niveau supérieur, nous souhaitons faire votre connaissance.
Envoyez-nous votre dossier de candidature complet et montrez-nous avec des exemples concrets :
* Quelle amélioration mesurable avez-vous réalisée dans une organisation précédente ?
* Quel processus avez-vous digitalisé ou automatisé avec succès ?
* Comment assurez-vous que les standards convenus sont durablement respectés dans les opérations quotidiennes ?
Nous attendons des personnalités qui ne se contentent pas de parler de changement, mais qui le mettent en œuvre de manière démontrable.

Der einzige dreisprachige Kanton der Schweiz ist wirtschaftlich, kulturell und politisch vielfältig. Die Kantonale Verwaltung Graubünden ist genauso vielseitig wie unsere Landschaft. Bringen Sie Ihre einzigartigen Fähigkeiten ein und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Kantonalen Verwaltung Graubünden.
Das Tiefbauamt ist für die Projektierung, den Bau, die Erhaltung und den Betrieb der Kantonsstrassen sowie den Wasserbau und den Langsamverkehr in Graubünden zuständig. Ausserdem kümmern wir uns um den betrieblichen Unterhalt der Nationalstrassen auf dem Kantonsgebiet.

Die Strasseninfrastruktur des Kantons umfasst über 1'450 Kunstbauten, darunter Brücken in luftigen Höhen bis 90 Meter und Tunnels mit bis zu 3 Kilometern Länge. Die Herausforderungen, die die Natur unseres Gebirgskantons im und mit sich bringt, macht unsere Arbeit anspruchsvoll und vielseitig.

We're looking for a proactive and technically confident Assistant Site Manager to support the day-to-day running of our immersive VR experience in a high-footfall Bristol venue. Working closely with the Event Manager, you'll help keep the visitor experience running smoothly, staff well supported, and systems fully
operational.

· Monitor experience performance throughout the day, resolving disruptions or resets promptly.

· Maintain stock of consumables (e.g., sanitisation wipes, headset liners) and uphold hygiene protocols.

· Assist in keeping technical documentation up to date and support training of team members on troubleshooting procedures.
🏛 Venue Operations (Ground Floor)

· Help ensure the ground floor VR experience space is clean, safe, and visitor-ready at all times.

· Coordinate cleaning and reactive maintenance for the VR zone, including public and back-of-house areas.

· Support queue management, timed entry, and visitor flow, particularly during peak periods.
👥 Team Support & Holiday Cover

· Assist in line managing front-of-house staff, including agency team members, day to day.

· Support daily staff briefings, rota coordination, and shift cover.

· Model high standards of customer service and professionalism for the wider team.

· Help train new team members on VR-specific procedures, safety, and technical protocols.

· Take full ownership of team management, rotas, and briefings during any period covering for the Event Manager, ensuring continuity of standards and cover.
🛡 Health & Safety

· Support daily safety and cleanliness walkarounds of the VR area.

· Act as a trained first aider for the venue, leading incident response (first aid, equipment malfunctions, or guest complaints), including full responsibility for this when covering for the Event Manager.

· Help keep risk assessments for the VR zone up to date and log incidents or near misses.

· Ensure staff are trained in relevant H&S procedures, including emergency evacuations and manual handling (if required).
📣 Customer Experience

· Help maintain a welcoming, engaging, and inclusive atmosphere for all guests.

· Act as a point of escalation for visitor queries or complaints, and the main escalation point when covering for the Event Manager.

· Support customer feedback mechanisms and feed insights back to the Producer and Event Manager.
📝 Communication & Reporting

· Provide handovers to the Event Manager (or, during cover periods, directly to the Producer) covering technical issues, visitor numbers, and operational highlights.

· Maintain accurate logs: staff attendance, incident reports, daily checklists, and maintenance tickets.

· Ensure a clean handover back to the Event Manager after any period of holiday cover, flagging anything requiring follow-up.
Ideal Candidate Profile

· Experience in live event, visitor attraction, or venue operations — preferably in immersive or tech-driven environments.

· Working knowledge of VR hardware/software and basic IT troubleshooting (e.g., Windows PCs, networks, Wi-Fi, device calibration).

· Experience supporting or managing teams, including casual/agency staff, in high-traffic public settings.

· Working knowledge of health & safety regulations and customer service best practices.
Additional Info

· Some Mondays/Tuesdays may be required for maintenance, special events, or staff training.

**Location:** Vevey, Switzerland

**Contract type / duration:** Permanent contract
**Target start date:** As soon as possible

** **
**Be a force for good and** **grow through experiences** **that** **push you further.**
As Group Statutory Reporting Supervisor, you will be responsible for a defined portfolio of entities, overseeing Period End Closing, statutory reporting, and remaining accounting-related processes in the market.

You will act as guardian of market accounting policies and procedures, safeguarding balance sheet integrity, and serve as a key point of contact for Shared Services Centers on Accounting Operations questions and improvement initiatives.

In this role, you will also partner with the wider Finance community to strengthen controls, service quality, and end-to-end improvements.
**How you-ll make an impact as ****Group Statutory Reporting Supervisor**
* Coordinating Period End Closing in a network organization, including Shared Services, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
* Acting as a trusted partner and key link with the Finance community, including the CFOs, Business Controllers, Group Consolidation, external auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Ensuring compliance with Nestlé guidelines, instructions, and best practices across market-related scopes.
* Collaborating actively with Shared Services Centers and Functions to drive end-to-end improvement initiatives.
* Producing market statutory reporting in compliance with Swiss accounting regulations.
* Coordinating the completion of remaining in-market Group reporting responsibilities and publication, including equity reconciliation.
* Acting as a subject matter expert on specific IFRS and local GAAP requirements, including the Code of Obligations and Swiss GAAP FER.
**What will make you successful**
* Strong background in the Finance, Accounting, or a related field, complemented by a professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant or equivalent; a Swiss GAAP-specific certification, such as Swiss CPA or similar, is a strong asset.
* Bringing established experience in accounting and audit, ideally including tax accounting, gained within a Big 4 firm or a corporate international environment.
* Demonstrating significant in-house statutory accounting experience, with a proven track record of delivering finance and accounting projects.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively engage and communicate with management, Finance & Control leadership, and external parties, including external auditors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
* Significant and demonstrated experience in in-house statutory accounting.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel; experience with SAP and CFiN is an advantage.

Als **Projektingenieur / Projektleiter Bau** bei der **Nestlé Suisse** besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Planung, Koordination und Realisierung von Bauprojekten unterschiedlicher Komplexität für unsere THOMY Fabrik in Basel sicherzustellen.

Das Aufgabenspektrum reicht von kleineren Unterhalts- und Sanierungsmassnahmen bis hin zu Neu- und Umbauprojekten. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit internen Kunden, Behörden, Planern, Architekten, Ingenieuren und Unternehmern zusammenarbeiten.

Dies ist Ihre Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihre Expertise weiterzuentwickeln und die Zukunft unseres Produktionsstandorts aktiv mitzugestalten.
**So werden Sie als Projektingenieur / Projektleiter Bau einen Unterschied machen**
* Selbstständige Leitung und Begleitung von Bauprojekten von der Bedürfnisdefinition bis zur Inbetriebnahme.

* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher sowie Nestlé-interner Vorschriften zur Arbeitssicherheit, interner Vorgaben, Qualitätsstandards und Compliance-Richtlinien für den Bereich Bau sowie Ansprechperson für interne Kunden, Behörden, Planer und Unternehmer.
**Das macht Sie erfolgreich**
